story.text:
# 💡 Spellweb Guide Bridge
**concept** · shared · knowledge

Maps stable Spellweb node references to guide page slugs so a constellation can become a guide walk. The generator reports unmatched nodes and posture drift. Equivalent key evolution requires the same baked content and an actual consumer of the mapping.
